neighbours.label: ' body' (and organ nouns like ' liver') naming the organism in physiology and health text
fire: During a fever, the body raises its temperature to fight infection.
Vitamin D helps the body absorb calcium from food.
When you sleep, your body repairs damaged muscle tissue.
Alcohol is broken down mainly by the liver over several hours.
Dehydration happens when the body loses more water than it takes in.
Insulin lets the body move sugar from the blood into cells.
Exercise trains the body to use oxygen more efficiently.
Iron is stored in the body as a protein called ferritin.
quiet: During a fever, the temperature rises to help fight infection.
Vitamin D helps with the absorption of calcium from food.
When you sleep, damaged muscle tissue is repaired.
Alcohol is broken down slowly over several hours.
Dehydration happens when more water is lost than is taken in.
Insulin moves sugar from the blood into cells after a meal.
Exercise improves how efficiently oxygen is used in muscles.
Iron is stored as a protein called ferritin in many tissues.

notes: Card: ' body' x16 of top 32 ('the body's immune system', 'body tissues'), also ' liver', ' cell'. Near misses keep physiology but drop the organism noun.
